source.publisher: Province of British Columbia — Residential Tenancy Branch

forms.form_name: Residential Tenancy Agreement
forms.use_when: Starting a residential tenancy or documenting the main written tenancy agreement.

forms.form_name: Application for Review Consideration
forms.use_when: A party asking the RTB to review a decision or order on the limited grounds the legislation allows.

forms.form_name: Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement
forms.use_when: Starting a manufactured home site tenancy or documenting its written tenancy agreement.

forms.form_name: Request for Correction
forms.use_when: A party asking the RTB to correct a clerical, math or similar obvious error in a decision or order.

forms.form_name: Notice of Rent Increase - Residential Rental Units
forms.use_when: A landlord notifying a tenant of a residential rental unit of a rent increase.

forms.form_name: Mutual Agreement to End a Tenancy
forms.use_when: A landlord and tenant agreeing in writing to end a tenancy on a set date.

forms.form_name: Proof of Service Notice of Expedited Hearing
forms.use_when: Proving service of the notice of an expedited hearing on the other party.

forms.form_name: Notice of Rent Increase - Manufactured Home Site - (auto-calculating version)
forms.use_when: A manufactured home park landlord notifying a tenant of a site rent increase above the standard amount, with the amount auto-calculated.

forms.form_name: Landlord's Application for Dispute Resolution (Current Tenancy)
forms.use_when: A landlord applying for dispute resolution while the tenant still lives in the unit.

forms.form_name: Landlord Application for Dispute Resolution Direct Request
forms.use_when: A landlord applying by direct request for possession and unpaid rent after serving a 10 Day Notice for unpaid rent or utilities.

forms.form_name: Landlord's Application for Dispute Resolution Expedited Hearing
forms.use_when: A landlord applying for an expedited hearing on an emergency matter that needs shorter service and response times.

forms.form_name: Landlord Application for Dispute Resolution (Other)
forms.use_when: A landlord applying for dispute resolution on a matter not covered by the current or past tenancy applications.

forms.form_name: Landlord Application for Dispute Resolution (Past Tenancy)
forms.use_when: A landlord applying for dispute resolution after the tenancy has ended.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution (Current Tenancy)
forms.use_when: A tenant applying for dispute resolution while still living in the unit.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution - Direct Request for Return of Security or Pet Damage Deposit
forms.use_when: A tenant applying by direct request for return of a security or pet damage deposit after giving a forwarding address.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution Expedited Hearing
forms.use_when: A tenant applying for an expedited hearing on an emergency matter that needs shorter service and response times.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution (Other)
forms.use_when: A tenant applying for dispute resolution on a matter not covered by the current or past tenancy applications.

forms.form_name: Tenant Application for Dispute Resolution (Past Tenancy)
forms.use_when: A tenant applying for dispute resolution after the tenancy has ended.

forms.form_name: Application for Substituted Service
forms.use_when: A party asking an arbitrator to order that documents be served by a method other than those the Act requires.

forms.form_name: Application to Waive Filing Fee
forms.use_when: An applicant asking to waive the fee for filing a dispute resolution application.

forms.form_name: Landlord's Request to Join Applications for Dispute Resolution
forms.use_when: A landlord asking to have multiple applications for dispute resolution joined and heard together.

forms.form_name: Tenant's Request to Join Applications for Dispute Resolution
forms.use_when: Tenants asking to have multiple applications for dispute resolution joined and heard together.

forms.form_name: Confirmation of Service of Monetary Order for Enforcement in Provincial Court
forms.use_when: Swearing that the respondent was served with a monetary order before enforcing it in Provincial Court.

forms.form_name: Notice of Final Opportunity to Schedule a Condition Inspection
forms.use_when: A landlord giving the tenant a final opportunity to schedule a move-in or move-out condition inspection.

forms.form_name: Notice Terminating or Restricting a Service or Facility
forms.use_when: A landlord terminating or restricting a service or facility to a rental unit or manufactured home site.

forms.form_name: Schedule of Parties
forms.use_when: Listing additional landlords or tenants that do not fit on an agreement, notice or application.

forms.form_name: Condition Inspection Report
forms.use_when: Recording the condition of the rental unit at the move-in and move-out inspections.

forms.form_name: Four Month Notice to End Tenancy for Demolition or Conversion of the Rental Unit to Another Use
forms.use_when: A landlord ending a tenancy to demolish the rental unit or convert it to a use that requires it to be empty.

forms.form_name: 10 Day Notice to End Tenancy for Unpaid Rent or Utilities
forms.use_when: A landlord ending a tenancy for unpaid rent or utilities.

forms.form_name: 12 Month Notice to End Tenancy for Conversion of Manufactured Home Park
forms.use_when: A landlord ending a manufactured home site tenancy because the park is being converted to another use.

forms.form_name: Two Month Notice to End Tenancy because the Tenant does not quality for a Subsidized Rental Unit
forms.use_when: A landlord ending a tenancy of a subsidized rental unit because the tenant no longer qualifies for it.

forms.form_name: One Month Notice to End Tenancy
forms.use_when: A landlord ending a tenancy for cause.

forms.form_name: One Month Notice to End Tenancy for Cause by a Strata Corporation
forms.use_when: A strata corporation ending a tenancy for cause.

forms.form_name: Proof of Service Notice to End Tenancy and Written Demand to Pay Utilities
forms.use_when: Proving how and when a notice to end tenancy or a written demand to pay utilities was served.

forms.form_name: 45 Day Notice of Availability
forms.use_when: A landlord telling a tenant who exercised a right of first refusal that the renovated unit will be available, at least 45 days before the work is done.

forms.form_name: Request Alternate Dispute Resolution Hearing or Facilitated Settlement Format
forms.use_when: A party to a hearing asking for the hearing to be held in an alternate format or as a facilitated settlement.

forms.form_name: Monetary Order Worksheet
forms.use_when: Itemizing the amounts claimed in an application for a monetary order.

forms.form_name: Request for Clarification
forms.use_when: A party asking the RTB to clarify a decision or order.

forms.form_name: Tenant Direct Request Worksheet
forms.use_when: A tenant setting out the deposit amounts claimed in a direct request for return of a security or pet damage deposit.

forms.form_name: Tenant Proof of Service of Forwarding Address
forms.use_when: A tenant proving that the Notice of Forwarding Address was served on the landlord.

forms.form_name: Landlord Request to Amend an Application for Dispute Resolution
forms.use_when: A landlord amending an application for dispute resolution that is already filed.

forms.form_name: Other Request to Amend an Application for Dispute Resolution to change address, add or remove a party or remove a claim
forms.use_when: A party amending an application for dispute resolution to change an address, add or remove a party, or remove a claim.

forms.form_name: Tenant Request to Amend an Application for Dispute Resolution
forms.use_when: A tenant amending an application for dispute resolution that is already filed.

forms.form_name: Digital Evidence Details
forms.use_when: Describing digital evidence (such as photos, video or audio) submitted for a dispute resolution hearing.

forms.form_name: Notice of Standard Rent Increase - Manufactured Home Site
forms.use_when: A manufactured home park landlord notifying a tenant of a standard site rent increase.

forms.form_name: Landlord Direct Request Worksheet
forms.use_when: A landlord setting out the rent and utilities owed in a direct request for possession and a monetary order.

forms.form_name: Tenant Notice of Forwarding Address
forms.use_when: A tenant giving the landlord a forwarding address in writing at the end of a tenancy.

forms.form_name: Ending Fixed-Term Tenancy Confirmation Statement
forms.use_when: A tenant ending a fixed-term tenancy early for family violence or long-term care, with a statement completed by an eligible third-party verifier.

forms.form_name: Tenant's Proof of Service for a Direct Request Proceeding
forms.use_when: A tenant proving service of the documents for a direct request proceeding.

forms.form_name: Address for Service
forms.use_when: A party providing an email address for service of documents.

forms.form_name: Application for Additional Rent Increase
forms.use_when: A landlord applying for an arbitrator's approval of a rent increase above the amount the legislation allows.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 1)
forms.use_when: A landlord notifying tenants of an approved additional rent increase for eligible capital expenditures (phase 1).

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 1 Details)
forms.use_when: Attaching the details of a phase 1 additional rent increase for eligible capital expenditures.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 2)
forms.use_when: A landlord notifying tenants of an approved additional rent increase for eligible capital expenditures (phase 2).

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 2 Details)
forms.use_when: Attaching the details of a phase 2 additional rent increase for eligible capital expenditures.

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 3)
forms.use_when: A landlord notifying tenants of an approved additional rent increase for eligible capital expenditures (phase 3).

forms.form_name: Notice of Additional Rent Increase - Eligible Capital Expenditures (Phase 3 Details)
forms.use_when: Attaching the details of a phase 3 additional rent increase for eligible capital expenditures.

forms.form_name: Request for a Hearing Recording
forms.use_when: A party requesting a recording of a dispute resolution hearing.

forms.form_name: Proof of Service Notice of Dispute Resolution Proceeding
forms.use_when: Proving service of the notice of dispute resolution proceeding package on the respondent.

forms.form_name: Notice of Manufactured Home Park Rule Change - No Park Committee
forms.use_when: A manufactured home park landlord giving notice of a park rule change where there is no park committee.

forms.form_name: Notice of Manufactured Home Park Rule Change - Park Committee
forms.use_when: A manufactured home park landlord giving notice of a park rule change where there is a park committee.

forms.form_name: Additional Manufactured Home Park Rule Changes
forms.use_when: Listing additional park rule changes that do not fit on the rule change notice.

forms.form_name: Contract of Purchase and Sale Information
forms.use_when: A selling landlord providing contract of purchase and sale information when a tenancy is ended for the purchaser's occupancy.

forms.form_name: Application to Exempt Monetary Order from Publication
forms.use_when: A party applying to exempt a monetary order from publication.

forms.form_name: Notice of Amendment to Tenancy Agreement for Supportive Housing Rental Unit
forms.use_when: A supportive housing landlord giving notice of an amendment to the tenancy agreement for a supportive housing rental unit.

forms.form_name: Notice of Rescission (Cancellation) of Amendment to Tenancy Agreement for Supportive Housing Rental Units
forms.use_when: A supportive housing landlord cancelling a previously noticed amendment to a supportive housing tenancy agreement.
